data.heading: 1. Rabi Season harvest and Summer Season Sowing Status:
data.text:
-  As  per  3 rd Advance  Estimates  2025-26,  the  area  sown  under  the  summer  crops  is  87.26  lakh  ha  as compared to 83.91 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. As compared to previous year, Rice area declined by 0.65 lakh ha whereas, Maize area increased by 2.08 lakh ha, Groundnut by 1.03 lakh ha, Urad by 0.76 lakh ha and Shree Anna by 0.70 lakh ha.
-  As on 01.06.2026, rabi crops harvesting has been completed in all states.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  As  per  3 rd   Advance  Estimates  2025-26,  about  116.3  percent  of  the  normal  area  has  been sown under the summer season crops.
-  Rice: About  32.63  lakh  ha  area  coverage  under  Summer  Rice  has  been  reported  as compared to 33.28 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses: About  27.16  lakh  ha  area  coverage  has  been  reported  compared  to  27.07  lakh  ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds: About 10.62 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 9.51 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
